description: ONS: Geração por Usina em Base Horária, published by Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico (ONS), reports hourly generation for individual plants, plant sets and small-plant groups. Coverage: The product covers Brazil's interconnected electricity system, with the aggregation and equipment thresholds in its definition. Temporal resolution: hourly. Coverage: Annual files for 2000-2021; monthly files from 2022. The linked ONS CKAN API identifies the product and its downloadable formats. Observation files and attached data dictionaries were not downloaded. The provider labels the product Creative Commons Attribution (CC-BY), without a version in the reviewed metadata. Public metadata access required no registration; attribution and change disclosure remain applicable. Limitations: Type III small-plant groups use generation forecasts, whereas other entries represent verified generation. Do not label every value as measured. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support capacity planning, network flow studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
